description: Aircraft and vessel registry records and bounded movement samples under documented licence and volume bounds (#2221): FAA and UK CAA G-INFO registry revisions, OpenSky samples for one named ICAO address and a 48-hour window, GFW port visits with GFW confidence (vessel identity cited from the Fisheries pack), open AIS samples for one named MMSI, UNCTAD port-call aggregates; derived calls with coverage caveats, reviewable identity through ownership identity, and citation links to sanctions listings.

semantic_constraints.feature_flag: NOESIS_OSINT_MOVEMENTS; movement_registry is served only with it, and movement_window and movement_calls also need the osint-review gate (NOESIS_OSINT_GATED_TOOLS) and the knowledge:osint:movements scope, so they are not catalog operations
semantic_constraints.bounds: one named identifier and a window of at most 92 days per question; per-source windows and sample counts in docs/security/osint-movements-access.md; no area, background or real-time query and no continuous ADS-B/AIS mirroring
semantic_constraints.coverage: absence of positions is 'no coverage observed', never absence of movement or presence
semantic_constraints.persons: natural-person registrants never keyed, matched or shown; opted-out (LADD/PIA) aircraft and aircraft registered to a natural person refused; person-keyed identifiers refused
semantic_constraints.calls: source-published calls keep the source's confidence; derived calls carry method, samples, facility geometry and the gaps that make them uncertain
semantic_constraints.identity: time-bounded exact identifier matches and organisation candidates through ownership.identity (movements: keys); records never merged
semantic_constraints.sanctions: links only on an identifier the listing states; name-only similarity is a candidate; no evasion, screening or compliance verdict
semantic_constraints.monitoring: registry, identity and listing changes through platform.subscriptions; position and call subscriptions refused
semantic_constraints.purpose_log: every position-bearing request is logged with its stated purpose
